workLog.activity: First push attempt failed pre-pr-validation's Session End Validation
workLog.finding: The first draft of this log honestly recorded five sessionStart MUST items as not done and used a "SKIPPED: docs-only" qaValidation evidence value. validate_must_item hard-fails any MUST item with Complete:false regardless of stated reason (no N/A escape), and validate_qa_skip_scope's docs-only checker (test_docs_only_eligibility.py, _is_doc_file) only accepts .md paths, so it was always going to reject a diff containing .agents/sessions/*.json and .agents/memory/episodes/*.json. Fixed by actually performing the missing steps (reading HANDOFF.md, reading the Serena-fallback memory file, listing a skill's scripts directory) rather than marking them done without doing them, and by writing a real QA report instead of the disqualified skip.

workLog.activity: Copilot bot review on PR #5219: triaged 5 findings
workLog.finding: Verified each against the actual code rather than accepting or dismissing on sight. Two were correct and fixed: validationPassed's evidence field was written before the test-fix and QA-rebind commits landed and had gone stale (contradicted this same log's own workLog), and the QA report's Findings section undersold the diff as pure documentation when it also fixes a real (non-runtime) test defect; both corrected here. A third was correct on the underlying critique (test_workflow_sets_up_uv used a raw substring match, testing.md MUST 9 requires parsed structure) and fixed by parsing the workflow YAML and asserting on the 'Setup uv' step's uses field. A fourth (claiming any ADR-*.md edit requires a fresh 6-agent adr-review round) is contradicted by the hook itself: check_adr_review_policy's _is_frontmatter_only_metadata_change/_only_implemented_field_changed (scripts/validation/git_hook_policy.py:1247-1267) is a purpose-built exemption for exactly this edit shape (body byte-identical, only the implemented key changed), and it already ran and passed locally on this branch's first commit. A fifth (delete the session-log artifacts because session-logs.md says logs are optional) is right that logs are optional but wrong that creating one here was improper: without it, branch-context-policy's exemption (a log for the current branch existing) could never fire on a fresh branch sharing a day with any other branch's log, which would have blocked every commit outright. Replied to both disagreements with citations rather than complying or staying silent.
